selection_rule: Previously inspected blog.blazingcdn.com and lowest snapshot SHA among other test hosts with 20k–100k source characters and at least three editable paragraphs. Chosen before any GEPA mutation exists.
comparison: Identical full host queries; within-page P1 mean; failures and abstentions retain measured original P1; no example swapping or prompt edits based on test results.
quality_limit: Two exposed P1-test hosts are a bounded dogfood check, not general superiority or an untouched final evaluation.
